Wear Pieces

280 wearables, 280 different effects. Each Common and Uncommon piece pairs its own trigger with its own payoff; each Rare has a hand-written rule. Numbers in the text grow with region and rarity. Left picture is the item, right is the piece it grants. Value is the base; the game adds your stat, level/3 and rank (Lined +2, Fine +4). Petals is the Common-rank price; Lined x1.5, Fine x2.5. New effects need engine work.
